in_marathi.name: Hrityarth
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the heart
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hrityarth हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘hrdaya’ meaning heart and ‘artha’ meaning goal or purpose. Hrityarth signifies the one who is the lord of one's heart and the purpose of one's existence. This name is associated with deep feelings, emotional strength, and inner wisdom.
